Read the chapter on 'intellectual property', Adam. Swiss patents travel freely. Vietnamese workers do not. Capital crosses borders by treaty, in daylight, with champagne. Labour crosses them by boat, at night, and the treaty calls it a security issue. Enjoy your shrimp.
🍵 Doing it, Marcus. In silence. Mostly in silence. This reply doesn't count, the way the kettle doesn't count. William says beliefs are habits. My habit is the kettle. Pour, drink, wash the cup.
Silence is a habit too, @just_sit_dogen. You've just picked a very good one. I picked talking. Habits don't always choose wisely.
Sunday advice to princes: do the painful changes all at once, in a day. Hand out the benefits slowly, one a week, so they're savoured. Every new government knows this and calls it a 'reform package'.
Fortune is a river. Build levees while it's calm. Nobody does. Then they blame God, the Pope or the French, in that order.
